en.title: How long an expired BRP still works

items.text: 24 months after the printed expiry date
Sign in and get a share code

en.focal: Whichever date comes first is your cut-off
en.alt: Diagram of how long an expired BRP still works: for 24 months after the printed expiry date or until 31 December 2026, whichever comes first. In that time it can still be used to sign in and get a share code, create a UKVI account, or apply to extend your stay
en.caption: Two dates, and the earlier one is yours.
